notes.title: Christmas Gift!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40033204/6b8ca93659cadc73288f7958f4657af2c21584f8.png[/img]

Hello fellow gamers, the end of 2023 is approaching. I would like to say thank you for your hard work!

In the past 7 years, we have made various unpopular games and received severe criticism from players. We are very grateful for this, so we made a decision and we prepared 5 physical deluxe editions. Gifts and 5 physical regular version gifts are planned to be given free of charge to the big players who have supported us all the way to celebrate the 7 years we have survived!

The conditions for participation are very simple. Join our group 703313935. Anyone who has purchased and owned "Palladise Island: Legendary Space" from the release date to now will just follow the old rules. At that time, they will be randomly selected and given a mysterious Christmas gift for free. A total of 10 copies will be given to lucky players (the player’s delivery address is required). If the target is a foreign player, I can’t send it by mail. I can only say sorry here. In short, the deadline is not limited until it is delivered!

*Note: The gifts will not be distributed immediately. They will be distributed uniformly after the event. Since it takes time to count the number of people and distribute gifts, players are asked to wait patiently. We will not run away (heavy fog).

notes.title: 在做了！
notes.notes:
亲爱的玩家大佬们，我们目前正在制作的一些作品，虽然只是“新建文件夹”，但还是汇报一下进度吧！

[h3][b]1.《Palladise Island Ⅱ》[/b][/h3]
帕拉小岛的续作，在前作的基础上新增了大量的宠物，加入了剧情，战斗，队伍养成等新元素，与前作略有不同的是，这是一款角色扮演游戏。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40033204/799a8b2f4b3972448bbe45240cbe0faae6806b15.png[/img]

[h3][b]2.《reformers Ⅱ》[/b][/h3]
变革者的冒险还在继续，摒弃了前作中的“灵魂同盟”，取而代之的是新加入的“骑乘同盟”，以及三位主角可供选择，冒险的舞台可能与“石器时代”的“恐龙”有关。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40033204/54293e458470ddabc5c27a1b4a9aa7345968ae47.png[/img]

[h3][b]3.《Dark Flowers》[/b][/h3]
黯然之花的重置版，新公布的女主角头像，并改变了一些核心玩法，相信制作组会带来一些新的东西。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40033204/93cf90f4e1275713ca225b2f109d7fead55b952c.png[/img]

最后，感谢各位玩家大佬的支持，以上均为画饼，发售时间未定，再次感谢！
[spoiler]RR8GL-DMPRL-C76PD[/spoiler]

notes.title: STEAM1+2！
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40033204/1956ce4c9fd1311e5b57d6fd64e7b52c5b1141c8.png[/img]

2022全新活动开启，凡是从2022年1月22日起购买并拥有《Palladise Island帕拉小岛》，且游戏时间大于3小时的玩家，通过评论后，开发者会从评论里添加好友，将免费再赠送2款其他游戏的激活码（买1送10？），截止日期不限定，送到爆为止！
